answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a sable bet on surviving 59 epochs of grading, and every tundra settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 59 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
